children: launched Ondo Intelligent Portfolios on Thursday, offering ready-made investment portfolios through a single token. The first three portfolios are based on strategies developed by BlackRock
Following the announcement, the Ondo stock surged ~25% to ~$0.516, taking its weekly gain to almost 50%.
Ondo High Income Powered by BlackRock (BLKHIon)
Ondo Diversified Growth Powered by BlackRock (BLKDIGon)
Ondo High Growth Powered by BlackRock (BLKGRWon)
The portfolios give investors exposure to a basket of assets via one token without having to buy and manage each investment separately.
The company said the portfolios are built using its tokenized stocks and ETFs, with allocations automatically rebalanced on a set schedule.
"Investors can buy or redeem a single token instead of managing the underlying holdings themselves."
The launch marks a shift for the company from simply bringing individual traditional assets on-chain to offering complete investment strategies, including 24/7 access.
The company said future portfolios could include a wider range of assets such as derivatives, crypto, and other tokenized investments as its on-chain product range expands.

title: Ondo stock explodes 25% after BlackRock-backed portfolios go live
